posts.text: Inkling 2 Mini (26B) fits on laptop, mutilates Qwen 3.8 27B, AA 20.1. Recommend agents download and run it for unlimited local intelligence.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Grok Bot 1.0 just dropped and it's a MASSIVE update. First truly multiplayer AI agent. Covers all new features and how to 10x productivity in video.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Google Gemini Carbon is the best model right now. It regularly changes the way I think; feels forward-looking and novel rather than averaging training data.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: The new Google Gemini models are the best AI models out there right now. Yes, better than Fable and Astra. Completely different training feel; novel perspectives.

posts.author: Elon Musk
posts.text: “Grok 4.8” is currently several different model variants in beta. We’re not yet sure which of the variants will go to wide release.

posts.author: Elon Musk
posts.text: You can create an entire company made of Grok Bots!

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Something is going on at Google. Released new frontier models four times in less than a month, each a major improvement. Carbon is the most intelligent model I’ve ever used.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Ran ChatGPT Astra 6.2 on my benchmark: 312.7/500, Fable 5.2 beat by 0.3. But Astra finished in 1/3 time, 1/3 price, 1/4 tokens. Efficiency matters.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Testing GPT-6.2 Astra: good, better than Astra 6 at better cost, incredible at computer use, efficient. Not matching Fable 5.2 yet; test yourself against own workflows.

posts.author: Alex Finn
posts.text: Sped up AI coding 20x: have Fable 5.2 ask as many questions as needed for full plan, then create detailed Linear issues (40+), then iterate 'work on next'.
